# Configuration

File: `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/qs-win-11/settings.json`. Only keys you change are stored; everything else follows the defaults below. Nested keys are written as nested objects:

```json
{
    "schemaVersion": 1,
    "values": {
        "theme": {
            "mode": "light"
        },
        "taskbar": {
            "alignment": "left"
        }
    }
}
```

Invalid values are ignored, logged as `settings.invalid` and shown in Settings. The file is watched and changes apply live.

## theme

| Key | Type | Default | Allowed | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `theme.mode` | enum | `"dark"` | `light`, `dark`, `auto` | Light, dark, or switch automatically at the times below. |
| `theme.lightStartsAt` | text | `"07:00"` | `^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$` | 24-hour HH:MM, used when the theme is auto. |
| `theme.darkStartsAt` | text | `"19:00"` | `^([01]\d|2[0-3]):[0-5]\d$` | 24-hour HH:MM, used when the theme is auto. |
| `theme.accentColor` | color | `"#0078d4"` |  | Color for highlights, toggles and the active app indicator, as #RRGGBB. |
| `theme.fontFamily` | text | `"Inter"` |  | Any installed font family. |
| `theme.scale` | number | `1` | 0.75 to 2 | Multiplies every size in the shell. |
| `theme.transparency` | boolean | `true` |  | Translucent taskbar and flyouts. Blur comes from your compositor. |
| `theme.reduceMotion` | boolean | `false` |  | Makes animations nearly instant. |
